Punjab Police busts Pakistan-linked terror module, arrests operative

Punjab Police announced on Tuesday the dismantling of a terror module linked to Pakistan-based Babbar Khalsa International (BKI). A key operative was arrested during the operation. The police stated the module was involved in terror activities and that the arrested individual was a significant member. Further details regarding the specific plot or the operative's role were not immediately disclosed in the coverage.
